outcome: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) risk in children aged 0-14 years
cohort: 1,142 children (cases and controls) from three Saudi Arabian regions
finding: The study found that early exposure to cow's milk, birth weight >4 kg, rural residency, family history of T1D, and maternal age >25 years were significant risk factors for T1D in children.
mod_finding: 31% of the case group were delivered by cesarean section, which was higher than the controls (χ2 = 4.12, P-value = 0.042).
birth_weight: Mentioned as a risk factor (>4 kg)
